name: Exotic forage & weeds
description: Introduced pasture grasses, legumes and weeds - white clover, Dactylis, Holcus, Hordeum, Vicia, Taraxacum, Plantago - the green subsidy on which rabbits and livestock both thrive. Functional group pooling 24 source nodes (1 native, 15 exotic, 8 mixed-origin); the source paper stresses that the rabbit shares most of these forage plants with sheep (21 shared nodes) and cattle (19).
